root.name: クラトス・ディフェンス

relations.text: 2022年に、Blue Halo(AeroVironmentが買収)から約1.6億ドルの契約獲得の可能性を得た
relations.text_en: In 2022, received an approximate $160 million potential contract award from Blue Halo (acquired by AeroVironment)

source.label: Kratos Defense 10-K
source.quote: Related to certain of these investments, in 2022, we received an approximate $160 million potential contract award from Blue Halo (acquired by AeroVironment) and a significant contract award from Intelsat (acquired by SES) as a result of Kratos OpenSpace™ products and technology.
source.note: 買収後のBlue Halo経由の記載です。
source.note_en: Refers to Blue Halo, which AeroVironment later acquired.

companies.name: ノースロップ・グラマン

relations.text: Northrop Grumman(Kratosのチームメイト)が競争入札で受注したと説明している
relations.text_en: Describes Northrop Grumman as Kratos' teammate that was competitively awarded a U.S. contract

source.label: Kratos Defense 10-K
source.quote: arc jet and coupled fiber laser facility for hypersonic materials evaluations, known internally as Project Helios, and a recent announcement that Kratos’ teammate Northrop Grumman was competitively awarded the U.S.
source.note: 受注内容は引用の範囲では不明です。
source.note_en: The contract details are not shown in the quote.

relations.text: Kratosが率いる宇宙軍の地上システム案件のチームに、Northrop Grummanが加わっている
relations.text_en: Northrop Grumman is part of the team Kratos leads on a Space Force ground system contract

source.label: Kratos Defense の発表
source.quote: Kratos will serve as the system integrator, leading a team including Northrop Grumman , Auria , ASRC Federal Systems Solutions and Rise8 , to establish fully operational primary and backup mission operations capabilities.

relations.text: AirbusとKratosは、2029年までに戦闘対応の無人僚機CCAを納入する計画で順調に進んでいる
relations.text_en: Airbus and Kratos are on track to deliver a combat-ready uncrewed Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA) by 2029

source.label: KTOS / Airbus — official relationship source; checked October 17, 2026
source.label_en: KTOS / Airbus — official relationship source; checked October 17, 2026
source.quote: This key milestone confirms that Airbus and Kratos are on track to deliver a combat-ready uncrewed Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA) by 2029, addressing the operational requirements of the German and other European Armed Forces.

relations.text: クラトス・ディフェンスの年次報告が、競合として挙げている
relations.text_en: Named as a competitor in Kratos’s annual report

source.label: Kratos Defense 10-K
source.quote: Tier two competitors include smaller government contractors such as Mercury Systems, Qinetiq, Cobham, CACI, Peraton, Linquest (now owned by KBR), Viasat and AAR Corp.

relations.text: KratosとKAIは、有人無人機の連携技術を進める戦略的提携を結んだ
relations.text_en: Kratos formed a strategic partnership with Korea Aerospace Industries to advance Manned-Unmanned Teaming technologies

source.label: Kratos Defense の発表
source.quote: Kratos Defense & Security Solutions, Inc. (Nasdaq: KTOS), a leading technology company in the defense, national security, and global markets, today announced the formation of a strategic partnership with Korea Aerospace Industries (KAI), a major Korean defense organization to advance Manned-Unmanned Teaming (MUM-T) technologies and capabilities.

relations.text: KratosとGE Aerospaceは、無人機向けの推進技術を進める正式な共同開発契約を発表した
relations.text_en: Kratos and GE Aerospace announced a formal teaming agreement to advance propulsion technologies for unmanned aircraft

source.label: Kratos Defense の発表
source.quote: Kratos Defense & Security Solutions, Inc. (Nasdaq: KTOS), a Technology Company in the Defense, National Security and Global Markets, and GE Aerospace (NYSE: GE) today announced a formal teaming agreement to advance propulsion technologies for the next generation of affordable unmanned aerial systems and Collaborative Combat Aircraft-type (CCA-type) aircraft.

relations.text: KratosはSKY Perfect JSATから、5G NTN地上システムの開発と検証に選ばれた
relations.text_en: Kratos was selected by SKY Perfect JSAT to develop and validate its 5G NTN ground system

source.label: Kratos Defense の発表
source.quote: Kratos Defense & Security Solutions, Inc. (Nasdaq: KTOS), a technology company specializing in Defense, National Security and Global Markets, today announced that it has been selected by SKY Perfect JSAT Corporation (SKY Perfect JSAT) to develop and validate the 5G Non-Terrestrial Network (NTN) ground system for SKY Perfect JSAT’s Universal NTN initiative.
source.note: 発表では事業会社のSKY Perfect JSAT Corporationが相手です。
source.note_en: The release names SKY Perfect JSAT Corporation, the operating company.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
